settingsForm.heading: Alert on {{ticker}}
settingsForm.description: Tell me when {{ticker}} moves by more than this much, either way, inside the window. Repeat alerts on the same move are held back for a few minutes.

panel.title: Recent activity
panel.crashBody: The rest of the dashboard is unaffected.
panel.suppressedBody: The price cache is not answering, so no threshold is being evaluated and nothing new will fire. Dashboard prices are unaffected — they come straight from the provider. Alerting starts again on its own once the cache is back.
panel.simulateFailure: Set a threshold on one of your positions first.
panel.loadFailure: Could not load recent alerts. They are saved either way — this list will fill in on the next refresh.
panel.empty: Nothing has crossed a threshold yet. Set one on a position, then use Simulate.

liveBadge.liveTitle: Alerts are streaming from the server
liveBadge.offlineTitle: Alerts will be listed as soon as the connection is back

reconnectBar.reconnecting: Reconnecting to the alert stream. Nothing is lost — anything that fires while you wait will appear here.
reconnectBar.offline: You are offline. Alerts will start again on their own once your connection is back.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.subtitle: Thresholds that have been crossed recently, newest first
